name: pulp-browser-native
description: Pulp's registered pulp-import-design and pulp-design-ir-observe for the oracle, reimport and rejection lanes. html-browser evaluates the source in the pinned Chromium and lowers every painted node natively (--native-panel-lowering), so the render is drawn from nodes, not from the browser capture; html-browser-faithful is Pulp's default browser import, which paints the capture itself, and exists only for the oracle lane's conflation control. The oracle steps run Chromium directly (--headless --screenshot): no Pulp or Vellum code is between the browser and oracle.png, so a capture defect in an importer cannot also be the reference. Before the first import the staged inputs are copied to second/ and revision/ (revision/ then gets the corpus's sed edit), so the same source is imported again unchanged (second/) and after the corpus's revision edit (revision/); each import's capture provenance (capture.json) names the exact source bytes and browser it came from. Rejection kinds wrap the import and observe commands in the harness's outcome_recorder, which maps Pulp's messages to the corpus's neutral diagnostic codes. design-ir copies a DesignIR document and observes it; it carries the corpus's staged-asset raster case.

probes.name: provider
argv: grep -E '^PULP_SKIA_ICUDTL_FILE' '{root:build}/CMakeCache.txt'; grep -m2 -E 'Release|Commit' '{root:checkout}/external/skia-build/VERSION.md'; echo 'renderer: pulp::view::render_to_file ScreenshotBackend::skia (CPU raster)'; otool -L '{tool:observer}' | tail -n +2 | sed 's/ (.*//'
mkdir -p .stage && for f in * .[!.]*; do case "$f" in .stage|.|..|'.[!.]*') ;; *) cp -R "$f" .stage/ ;; esac; done && mv .stage second && cp -R second revision && sed -e "$1" "$0" > "revision/$0"

rm -rf oracle-profile; "$0" --headless=new --disable-gpu --disable-gpu-compositing --force-color-profile=srgb --lang=en-US --hide-scrollbars --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --disable-extensions --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --disable-sync --mute-audio --disable-features=MacAppCodeSignClone,Translate,MediaRouter,OptimizationHints --user-data-dir="$PWD/oracle-profile" --force-device-scale-factor="$1" --window-size="$2" --virtual-time-budget=3000 --screenshot="$PWD/oracle.png" "file://$PWD/$3" >/dev/null 2>oracle-stderr.txt; rc=$?; rm -rf oracle-profile; printf '{"window": "%s", "scale": "%s", "clip": [%s, %s]}\n' "$2" "$1" "$4" "$5" > oracle-request.json; exit $rc
